verdict.rationale: Better Auth documents defining roles and permissions through its organization and admin plugins and advertises built-in access control. A community user corroborates RBAC support. The evidence does not show how permissions are enforced or that roles are surfaced in session or JWT tokens for authorization checks. missing for 10: documented permission-check/enforcement API, evidence that roles and permissions appear in session tokens or JWT claims, hands-on corroboration of enforcement.

support.subject: As a developer, I can define roles and permissions and have them enforced and surfaced in session tokens for authorization checks

citations.quote: Assign roles and permissions to streamline project management, team coordination, and partnerships.
It allows administrators to perform various operations such as creating users, managing user roles, banning/unbanning users, impersonating users, and more.
Multi-tenancy built in. Teams, roles, invitations, and access control.
